weightedAverageMaturityDays.rationale: No issuer-published portfolio weighted-average maturity for USN reserves. Cannot invent look-through WAM across Fasanara (~71% of reserves at pin), Alpaca T-bills, and on-chain sleeves.

valuationCadenceDays.rationale: Accountable continuous Proof of Solvency publishes live reserves and liabilities (dashboard interval live; timeline points on 2026-07-27). Docs independently claim continuous independent real-time PoS via Accountable. Cadence treated as daily (1) for metric banding — continuous feed is at least daily. Dual-source: Accountable API snapshot + transparency docs.

creditQuality.basis: Deployment docs name Janus Henderson JAAA CLOs, Fasanara F-TAC private credit (short-duration fintech/SME/receivables), tokenized T-bills, Morpho/Euler lending, Pendle PTs. Accountable split at pin is dominated by Fasanara ($24.49M, ~71%). Limited: named institutional managers plus live allocation feed; no independent credit rating or third-party loss-ratio exam of the combined book.

seniority.basis: USN is documented as the 1:1 USD stablecoin; sUSN is the yield-bearing staked claim that receives 80% of raw returns (USN product docs). USN holders do not receive raw yield. Structural seniority of USN vs residual protocol equity is only partially specified — USN is the senior par claim among user tokens, but external fund share classes (F-TAC etc.) determine look-through seniority. Limited.

legalEnforceability.basis: Mint/redeem are permissioned for institutional KYC wallets (minting docs referenced from product page). Token is a protocol liability backed by mixed CeFi/TradFi/DeFi deployments rather than a registered public fund share. Dual-source: product docs + custody page naming Alpaca/Dinari, Ceffu, ForDefi, Fasanara fund custody. Limited contractual enforceability for retail secondary holders.

valuationCadence.basis: Live Accountable PoS with independent enclave/ZK pipeline (transparency docs + live API). sUSN exchange rate appears on Accountable timeline (sUSN 1.21072 at last timeline point). Adequate continuous valuation disclosure; not strong without monthly third-party NAV audit of off-chain fund sleeves.

maturityAndLiquidity.basis: Portfolio mixes liquid T-bills/DeFi with majority private-credit (Fasanara) and CLO exposure. Private-credit page acknowledges proprietary liquidity strategy vs typical quarterly fund liquidity. WAM unavailable. Limited maturity/liquidity transparency.

custody.basis: Custody page names Alpaca (FINRA/SIPC) via Dinari for T-bills/CLOs, Ceffu tri-party for funding-rate sleeve, ForDefi MPC for DeFi, and fund-level custody for Fasanara. Accountable split independently shows those venue labels with balances. Adequate named institutional custody + live split; not strong without independent legal segregation opinions per sleeve.

recovery.basis: Docs reference layered insurance coverage as a security pillar (7-part framework index) but this pass did not dual-source a measured insurance notional or holder recovery waterfall separate from Accountable overcollateralization (~1.38% at pin). Limited recovery design evidence.
